title: The two held-out targets of the closure's level-2 cards (P-585: y_b/y_t; P-638 under P-665: r = dm2_21/dm2_31)
written_by: the SM seat, 2026-11-05, at main's request (P-686, S4); relay section 350 announces this file's sha256
firewall: Measured values only. No frame value of any target appears here, and none was compared with these values.
for_main: Main does not open this file until the card that uses it runs; the card asserts its sha256.

derivation_rule.symmetrised_sigma: an asymmetric 1-sigma range +a/-b is symmetrised to (a + b)/2 before propagation
derivation_rule.ratio_sigma: relative errors combined in quadrature in log space; correlations between the inputs neglected (HZ2021: m_b and m_t share alpha_s, a positive correlation, so quadrature is conservative for m_b/m_t; NuFIT: dm2_21 and dm2_3l are fixed by different data, weakly correlated)
derivation_rule.IO_r: for the inverted ordering dm2_31 = dm2_32 + dm2_21, and sigma(ln|r|) is propagated from dm2_21 and dm2_32 with r = dm2_21/(dm2_32 + dm2_21)
derivation_rule.precision: derived values rounded to 6 significant figures; the card may recompute them from the inputs

y_b_over_y_t.definition: m_b(M_Z)/m_t(M_Z) in the full-SM MS-bar scheme, where m_f = y_f v_F/sqrt(2) with one v_F = 246 GeV, so the ratio is y_b/y_t exactly
y_b_over_y_t.scheme: MS-bar, full Standard Model (six quarks and three leptons active), m_f = y_f v_F / sqrt(2), v_F = 246 GeV

source.reference: Huang and Zhou, 'Precise values of running quark and lepton masses in the Standard Model', Phys. Rev. D 103, 016010 (2021), arXiv:2009.04851v2
source.pdf_sha256_note: identical to the hash main recorded on 2026-10-09 for the six's file (frontier/B1637_fits_on_the_ruled_branch/received/HZ2021_running_masses_MZ.json on main)
source.table_row: Table 2, the row 'MZ, Full SM'; each uncertainty the printed sqrt(delta_exp^2 + delta_trunc^2)
source.transcription: read from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout) and checked against main's transcription of the same row

y_b_over_y_t.same_file_as_the_six: yes: the six's data file's row (main's B1741 compare.py reads the same table); the scale and scheme are the six's (relay section 349, S1.2)

r.definition: r = dm2_21 / dm2_31 in the oscillation convention: (1, 2) the pair with the small splitting, m_2 > m_1; NO: dm2_31 > 0; IO: dm2_31 < 0 (so r < 0)
r.primary: NuFIT 6.0, Table 1, the data set 'IC24 with SK atmospheric data'; the card compares with the ordering the frame's own spectrum has (relay section 349, S2.1)

source.reference: I. Esteban, M. C. Gonzalez-Garcia, M. Maltoni, I. Martinez-Soler, J. P. Pinheiro and T. Schwetz, 'NuFit-6.0: Updated global analysis of three-flavor neutrino oscillations', JHEP 12 (2024) 216, arXiv:2410.05380v2 (28 Oct 2025, 'Published version, typos corrected')
source.table: Table 1 (bfp +- 1 sigma column); 'Note that dm2_3l = dm2_31 > 0 for NO and dm2_3l = dm2_32 < 0 for IO'
source.transcription: read from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout), the values exactly as printed
source.why_this_version: NuFIT 6.1 (which adds JUNO's first data) is announced on the collaboration's site, but nu-fit.org returned 503 (upstream connection timeout) on 2026-11-05, so its tables could not be read or hashed here; NuFIT 6.0 is the newest peer-reviewed global fit read and hashed. Main may substitute 6.1 before the card is sealed, and the announced hash then changes

JUNO_first_data.reference: JUNO Collaboration, 'First measurement of reactor neutrino oscillations at JUNO', arXiv:2511.14593v1 (18 Nov 2025)
JUNO_first_data.as_printed: for the normal mass ordering scenario: dm2_21 = (7.50 +- 0.12) x 10^-5 eV2; 'The results obtained for the inverted mass ordering scenario are fully compatible'
JUNO_first_data.role: read-out only: JUNO alone measures dm2_21, not dm2_31; the read-out pairs it with NuFIT 6.0's IC24 NO dm2_31

primary_IO.from: NuFIT 6.0 IC24 with SK-atm, IO (dm2_31 = dm2_32 + dm2_21)

readout_JUNO_NO.from: JUNO dm2_21 with NuFIT 6.0 IC24 NO dm2_31

r.ordering_note: NuFIT 6.0 IC24 with SK-atm prefers NO (IO at dchi2 = 6.1); the card does not grade the ordering, it reads the frame's own and compares r for that ordering

not_targets: y_tau/y_b (P-585: not clean), the PMNS angles and phase (P-665), the absolute neutrino masses
